title: Exhibition of license.
bodyText: A pilot, on boarding a vessel, and if required by the master thereof, shall exhibit the pilot's license or a photostatic copy thereof.
bodyHtml: §462A-9  Exhibition of license.  A pilot, on boarding a vessel, and if required by the master thereof, shall exhibit the pilot's license or a photostatic copy thereof. [L 1978, c 231, pt of §2; gen ch 1985]
